question: What attainment makes a practitioner dear to the yoginīs?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation can be attained together.
This attainment constitutes a great accomplishment.
Such accomplishment results in being dear to the yoginīs.
inference: One who attains the great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation becomes dear to the yoginīs.
plain_english: He may attain the great accomplishment of both enjoyment and liberation and become dear to the yoginīs.
